items.title: US removes all bombers from RAF Fairford base
items.summary: A statement says all bombers deployed to RAF Fairford have been "re-deployed to their home stations" in the US.

items.title: Green Party members back 'Zionism is racism' motion
items.summary: The vote has caused divisions among figures at the top of the party at its conference in Brighton.

items.title: I'm a classic old school Conservative, says Kemi Badenoch
items.summary: The Tory leader seeks to echo Margaret Thatcher as she sets out her guiding political principles.

items.title: Brazil election goes to run-off as right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro wins first round
items.summary: With neither candidate getting more than 50% of the vote, the election will go to a run-off on 25 October.

items.title: Yemen's government announces all-out war to reclaim land from Houthis
items.summary: The Yemeni president's announcement comes amid an exchange of strikes between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition.

items.title: Christa Pike's prognosis still unclear after failed execution, lawyer says
items.summary: Pike's lawyer says doctors are still trying to clear two lethal doses of pentobarbital from her body.

items.title: British Museum announces changes to ease Bayeux Tapestry queues
items.summary: Measures include extended opening hours, as well as an audio guide and additional seating for visitors.

items.title: Protesters gather as migrants brought ashore on south coast
items.summary: A dinghy was believed to be carrying 120 migrants, according to French media.
